About FedEx Supply Chain Inbound Receiving

Receiving Associates are the first hands that touch inventory when it arrives at a FedEx Supply Chain distribution center. Every pallet, carton, and loose item that flows into the facility must be verified against purchase orders, inspected for damage, scanned into the warehouse management system, and staged for put-away — all with zero tolerance for quantity errors that would cascade into picking inaccuracies and customer order failures downstream. Receiving is where inventory accuracy begins.

Position Overview

FedEx Supply Chain is hiring Receiving Associates to process inbound vendor shipments at distribution center facilities. You will unload inbound trailers, verify freight against purchase orders and advance ship notices, scan items into the WMS, and stage received inventory for forklift put-away. This is a daytime dock-side position critical to maintaining downstream inventory accuracy.

Key Responsibilities

  • Unload inbound vendor trailers using pallet jacks, transferring palletized and loose freight to the receiving staging area.
  • Verify received quantities and SKUs against purchase orders, flagging overages, shortages, and damaged items immediately.
  • Scan all received inventory into the warehouse management system, generating put-away tasks for forklift operators.
  • Inspect inbound freight for visible damage, documenting exceptions with photographs and carrier damage reports.
  • Stage verified pallets in designated put-away lanes organized by storage zone for efficient forklift processing.

Qualifications & Benefits

Must be 18+ years of age. No prior receiving or warehouse experience required — full training provided. Strong counting accuracy and attention to detail essential. Must lift up to 50 lbs and work at dock-side receiving areas. FedEx Supply Chain offers competitive receiving associate pay, daytime shift schedules, weekly paychecks, full medical/dental/vision, 401(k) matching, tuition assistance, and advancement into inventory control and lead positions.

jobs.description:

Hourly

  • Paid Training
  • Staff members enjoy a combination of remunerated PTO and public holidays
  • 401(k) Savings with Employer Matching on a 1-to-1 Basis
  • Companies use ESPP as a way to retain employees by offering a unique benefit
  • Medical coverage pays for the costs of medical care, including doctor visits, hospitalization, and prescription drugs
  • Basic and supplemental life insurance plans are designed to provide financial support to the family of the policyholder in the unfortunate event of their death

We offer the necessary tools and resources to help you climb the career ladder and reach new heights of success

Job Overview:

1st Shift

Schedule:

Primarily work Monday to Friday, with opportunities for overtime on weekends or beyond if necessary

Hours:

6:00am-2:30pm

With expertise in using material handling equipment like forklifts and pallet jacks, the General Warehouse Laborer is equipped to move, load, and unload materials throughout the facility and surrounding area.

Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Select vending and cold drink equipment that can effectively serve the sales requests.
  • It's crucial to utilize protective wrapping and attach the proper documentation (STO) to guarantee the safety and security of all outbound loads.
  • Follow CCCI's SOPs when aiding in the loading and unloading of trailers to assist with delivery operations. Use handhelds to update SAP and CONA, keeping track of inbound and outbound loads to ensure accuracy and accountability for the territories served by the Regional Operation Center.
  • Emphasize safety and cleanliness by completing all necessary pre- and post-trip evaluations, double-checking daily documentation for accuracy, and ensuring a tidy and obstacle-free work area.
  • Participate in various duties as directed, such as staging equipment and managing yard work, such as removing clutter and maintaining a neat appearance.
  • Use a switching system to move pup and 53' trailers to the docking location as needed.

There are certain traits that individuals must possess in order to be successful in their professional role. These traits are often referred to as knowledge, skills, and abilities, or KSAs

  • Proficient understanding of essential safety principles, including proper lifting methods and the adoption of personal safety clothing.
  • Possess expert-level forklift skills required to operate single-wide forklifts with finesse and accuracy.
  • Basic pallet-jack skills.
  • Elementary competence in mechanics and uncomplicated employment of tools.
  • Knowledgeable in handling different rudimentary machines.
  • Following written guidelines or instructions is essential for best practices.
  • Generate reports through handwritten or computer-based formats to track progress.
  • Follow verbal instructions.
  • Intermediate math skills.
  • A holistic understanding of the aspects that bolster productivity.
  • The ability to analyze the process of order building, optimize the loading workflow, and select the most efficient pick and load path.
  • Managing various processes at the same time is a fundamental part of maintaining an optimized system.
  • The skill of consistently counting incoming products and verifying them against the manifest is critical.
  • Consistently achieving accurate loading of trucks while following documentation requirements.
  • Exhibits superior interpersonal communication skills.
  • The job necessitates the ability to perform in extreme temperatures, noisy surroundings, slippery floors, and hazardous shards of glass.
  • Every once in a while, the requirement may arise to lift weights that exceed 25 pounds, although the frequency of such cases is low.
  • The capacity to remain seated for extended periods.
  • Regular movements on and off a forklift.
  • The opening and closing of truck dock doors play an essential role in the unloading and loading process.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Certification for forklift and pallet jack operation includes both theoretical and practical training to ensure safety and efficiency.
  • Switcher operation certification.
  • Obtaining a Class A commercial driver's license is mandatory in some cases.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Past familiarity with logistics handling.
  • It is critical to adhere to federal and state weight limitations to avoid fines and citations. Failing to comply with regulations can also lead to accidents and damage to the truck, trailer, and cargo.

Work Environment:

  • An environment that is both loud and lacks temperature regulation, varying between both high and low degrees.

jobs.title: Package Handler
jobs.description:
Job Description:

Pay Range:

The salary for this position varies based on experience, with an hourly rate of $18.00 to $22.70 on offer

Rate Frequency:

Hourly

Schedule:

The designated business days for our company are between Monday and Thursday, where we are available for service from 3:30pm until 2:00am

What sets us apart is the exceptional quality of our staff.

As a member of our organization, you'll enjoy a broad range of incentives, remuneration that is on par with industry standards, chances for professional growth, and opportunities for advancement. Our full-time collaborators, in particular, are eligible for:

  • Paid Training
  • The privilege of having both paid holidays and Paid Time Off
  • A 401(k) program in which the company matches employee contributions on a dollar-for-dollar basis
  • The Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) typically has a set enrollment period during which employees can elect to participate in the program
  • With group health insurance, employees can enjoy the benefits of affordable and reliable healthcare coverage, including preventative care, emergency services, and hospitalization
  • Understanding Basic Life Insurance

Elevate your career with our innovative training programs

Job Overview:

The Seasonal Automated Warehouse Package Handler is responsible for completing customer orders. They do so by taking necessary items and quantities as mentioned on a pick ticket or a computer screen. Upon taking these items, they place them on a designated conveyor or pallet. Their performance must meet the company's regulations with due consideration for safety, accuracy, and efficiency.

Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Assisting in the selection and handling of items in an automated environment involves using sophisticated machinery, software applications, and computers while following CCCI's established safety policies and procedures. Your multi-tasking skills, coupled with a quick decision-making ability, are invaluable in such a noisy and demanding environment.
  • Facilitates reliable warehouse procedures through team collaboration.
  • Exhibits versatility in adjusting to the requirements of the role by staying informed about the different work sections within the facility and satisfying the minimum performance criteria of each section, including but not limited to, HQS, Semi-Automated Lanes, Flow Rack, and Pallet Pick.
  • Ensuring that the warehouse functions without complications, you will assist in maintaining a hygienic environment by keeping your workstation free from refuse and clutter, mopping up any drips or spills that occur, and following the waste management and recycling practices as required.
  • Adheres to secure, accurate, and proficient protocols to regulate warehouse inventory and prevent shrinkage from exceeding acceptable levels.
  • To keep a warehouse running efficiently in a constantly changing environment, performs miscellaneous tasks as assigned.

Knowledge refers to the information and understanding that one has about a particular subject or domain, while skills are practical abilities that are developed through practice and experience, and abilities are innate talents or qualities that one possesses

  • Possessing the capability to perform in a swift atmosphere while walking and recurrently hoisting 30 lbs.
  • Aptitude to handle items weighing up to 75 pounds.
  • The aptitude to team up with others in a collaborative surrounding is a valuable ability.
  • Capable of streamlining and systematizing warehouse operations to promote efficiency and dependability.
  • The flexibility to adapt to the needs of different work domains and fulfill the minimum requirements of each area.
  • The aptitude to read and understand instructions shown on a computer display.
  • The capability to be meticulous and to distinguish our packages is of great importance.
  • Proficiency to work in an environment that lacks temperature control with high levels of noise.
  • Someone who is self-directed and continuously looks for ways to add value without being prompted.
  • A work environment that can adjust to meet the changing demands of the industry is referred to as flexibility.
  • The use of screens, monitors, and devices is a crucial aspect of performing accurate picking while adhering to a specific order.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • The experience gathered within the first three years of work.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Having a high school diploma or GED signals to employers that an individual has acquired basic knowledge, skills, and competencies.

Work Environment:

  • This location presents challenges for workers, as it lacks proper temperature control and experiences high levels of noise.

Our company takes pride in being an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer, which means that we treat all candidates fairly and equally, regardless of their background, gender, ethnicity, or religion.

jobs.title: Stock Inventory Associate
jobs.description:
Job Summary:

As a Fortune 50 company with over 350,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and a leader in American retail. Working at Target provides the opportunity to help families experience the joy of everyday life. We are deeply committed to supporting our communities, investing in the places we live, work, and play. Our team values relationships, fosters talent growth, and thrives together as one. At our core, we prioritize care, growth, and success together.

Roles and Duties:

  • Adhere to all safety policies and protocols to establish a safe work environment.
  • Engage in safety training programs to enhance your performance capabilities in a swiftly moving warehouse environment.
  • Handle the packaging, transportation, and distribution of goods for consumers and stores.
  • Ensure the meticulous management of products for retail fulfillment and customer drop-offs.
  • Ensure the smooth transportation of goods and effective inventory handling throughout the warehouse.
  • Make sure your workspace is clutter-free, organized, and clean at all times.
  • Timely attendance at work is crucial, along with accurately completing tasks as scheduled.
  • Work on addressing issues to foster continuous operational improvements.
  • Express a proactive and polite attitude when carrying out responsibilities independently or as a team member.

Requirements:

  • Able to frequently lift and carry merchandise weighing 35-50 lbs.
  • Able to occasionally lift and carry items up to 60 lbs.
  • Proficiency in maintaining an upright position, navigating, applying force, dragging, crouching, flexing, and extending during working hours.
  • Sustain a positive and professional approach whether in a team or independent work setting.
  • Core math competencies that entail counting, addition, and subtraction.
  • Competency in accurately comprehending and interpreting information found on labels, tickets, and other product-related documents.
  • Demonstrate proficiency in operating computer systems or handheld devices with minimal supervision following appropriate training.
  • Proficient in expressing thoughts verbally and in writing.
  • Ability to understand, converse in, and interpret English to follow safety guidelines, policies, and instructions effectively.

Additional Requirements:

  • Proficient in following instructions and utilizing powered machinery safely (e.g., Pallet Rider, Scissor Lift, Sit-Down & Stand-Up Forklift).
  • Experienced in working safely at heights of up to 40 feet whenever necessary.
  • Experienced in operating effectively in temperature-managed environments, such as refrigerators and freezers, over long periods.

Benefits:

Target team members may qualify for a comprehensive benefits package, subject to plan terms and employment eligibility. Employees also receive a 10% Target discount, plus an extra 20% off select wellness products, including fruits, vegetables, healthy foods, activewear, and tobacco cessation products.

Note:

Based on business needs and role requirements within Warehouse Operations, candidates may be considered for either a Warehouse Worker or Warehouse Associate position. The specific job responsibilities for each role are outlined in the application process.

jobs.title: Relogistics Services is hiring: FORKLIFT OPERATOR in Chicago
jobs.description:
As a Forklift Operator, you'll get to load and unload trailer with wooden pallets and move pallets inside our plants to keep manufacturing production moving efficiently!
We're looking for a motivated individual who will keep things moving at a safe and efficient pace!
HOURLY PAY
$19.00/hr.
SHIFT(S)
Monday - Friday 5:00 AM - 1:30 PM
LOCATION
Chicago, IL 60624
WHAT YOU'LL DO
* Unload deliveries of pallets and/or wood to the proper location inside the plant
* Move freshly cut and recycled wood to the appropriate worktable area
* Stack finished products into trailers or to storage areas up to a safe height
* Maintain a safe working environment by lifting, stacking, and transporting materials with all other plant personnel in mind
WHAT YOU'LL NEED
* 1-3 years of forklift experience
* Previous experience in a warehouse, logistics, lumber, carpentry, lumber, welding, roofing, and/or construction is strongly preferred
* Willingness to work in a labor intensive environment
* Ability to communicate effectively
* Willing to work overtime as needed
WHAT WE OFFER
* Competitive Pay, Holiday Pay, and Daily Pay – Access to your earned wages before payday!
* Referral Bonuses
* Long-Term Career Advancement
* Paid Time Off
* Medical, Dental, Vision, Basic Life, AD&D, and Short-Term & Long-Term Disability insurance for Eligible Full Time Employees
* 401(k) Retirement Plan
* Great Team Environment
WHAT IT'S LIKE
48forty Solutions is the largest pallet management services company in North America!
We provide end-to-end pallet solutions, from supply to retrieval, on-site services, reverse logistics, and packaging materials.
We are truly Pallet Management Made Simple, our workforce is the heart and soul of our business, and we're looking for our next Forklift Operator to join our team!
* Ability to work in extreme conditions to include, but not limited to, elements, heat, cold, and air particulate
* Repetitively lift up to 50-75 pounds and adjust body position to bend, stoop, walk, turn, pivot, and sit in a forklift for entire shifts of varying lengths in time
* The noise level in the work environment is dependent on location
* Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) is required (eye protection, ear protection is mandatory at several locations, safety shoes)
* Specific vision abilities required by this job include, close vision, distance vision and color vision
48forty Solutions is an equal opportunity employer.
PAY RANGE
Starting from USD $19.00/Hr.
